introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure campus Wi-Fi management system for a university that provides wireless access to students, faculty, staff, and guests across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should use centralized authentication, role-based access control, separate guest access from internal university resources, monitor active wireless sessions, detect repeated authentication failures and unauthorized access attempts, and generate security alerts.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: Network administrators should be able to configure wireless access policies, review connected devices, revoke access, and inspect audit logs.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The solution should support university-managed and approved personal devices and remain secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable across multiple campus locations.

open_issues: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?
What conditions define unauthorized access attempts?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?

functional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: provide wireless access to students, faculty, staff, and guests across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices
requirements.statement: The system shall provide wireless access to students, faculty, staff, and guests across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices.

acceptance_criteria.given: system provides wireless access to students, faculty, staff, and guests across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates a connection request from a user in an academic building
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is granted authenticated wireless access with no service interruption observed
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: use centralized authentication
requirements.statement: The system shall use centralized authentication.

acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates an authentication request for a user
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns a valid authentication response from the centralized authority
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: use role-based access control
requirements.statement: The system shall use role-based access control.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system applies role-based access control
acceptance_criteria.when: a user attempts to access a resource with permissions beyond their assigned role
acceptance_criteria.then: The system observes the access decision and records the response-message wording as undecided.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: separate guest access from internal university resources
requirements.statement: The system shall separate guest access from internal university resources.

acceptance_criteria.given: guest access is separated from internal university resources
acceptance_criteria.when: a guest device attempts to access an internal university resource
acceptance_criteria.then: The guest device is denied access to the internal university resource.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: monitor active wireless sessions
requirements.statement: The system shall monitor active wireless sessions.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system monitors active wireless sessions
acceptance_criteria.when: a wireless session is established on a network segment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records the session details and maintains an active session list
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: detect repeated authentication failures
requirements.statement: The system shall detect repeated authentication failures.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system detects repeated authentication failures
acceptance_criteria.when: a user attempts to authenticate multiple times with incorrect credentials
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?

requirements.title: detect unauthorized access attempts
requirements.statement: The system shall detect unauthorized access attempts.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system detects unauthorized access attempts
acceptance_criteria.when: a user or device accesses a resource without valid authorization
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define unauthorized access attempts?

requirements.title: generate security alerts
requirements.statement: The system shall generate security alerts.

acceptance_criteria.when: a detection event occurs such as repeated failures or unauthorized access
acceptance_criteria.then: the system produces a security alert that is visible in the monitoring interface
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Network administrators to configure wireless access policies
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Network administrators to configure wireless access policies.

acceptance_criteria.given: Network administrators configure wireless access policies
acceptance_criteria.when: initiate configuration of wireless access policies
acceptance_criteria.then: the configured policy is applied to the wireless network and visible in the system interface
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Network administrators to review connected devices
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Network administrators to review connected devices.

acceptance_criteria.given: Network administrators request review of connected devices
acceptance_criteria.when: request a list of currently connected devices
acceptance_criteria.then: the requested list of connected devices is returned and displayed for examination
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow Network administrators to revoke access
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Network administrators to revoke access.

acceptance_criteria.given: Network administrators revoke access for a device
acceptance_criteria.when: initiate revocation of access for a specific device
acceptance_criteria.then: access is removed from the device and the system reflects the updated access status
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow Network administrators to inspect audit logs
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Network administrators to inspect audit logs.

acceptance_criteria.then: Network administrators inspect audit logs; external test capture records the inspection response.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

requirements.title: support university-managed and approved personal devices
requirements.statement: The system shall support university-managed and approved personal devices.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system is configured with a university-managed and approved personal device from the list of supported types
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates a secure connection using that device
acceptance_criteria.then: the connection succeeds without security failure or service interruption
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: What criteria determine whether a device is approved?
